Introduction

Jinyoung (born Park Jinyoung) is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and actor under BH Entertainment. He debuted in 2012 as part of the duo JJ Project alongside Jay B before re-debuting in January 2014 as the lead vocalist and visual of GOT7 under JYP Entertainment.

Beyond music, Jinyoung has built a successful acting career. He made his acting debut in "Dream High 2" (2012) and later took supporting roles in "When a Man Falls in Love" (2013) and "Beloved Eun-dong" (2015). In 2016, he made his big-screen debut in the independent film "A Stray Goat."

Following his departure from JYP Entertainment in 2021, Jinyoung signed with BH Entertainment and continued to pursue both music and acting. On May 8, 2023, he enlisted as an active-duty soldier.
